rationale: H0A0 establishes that proof leverage, not information non-factorization, is the primary realization qualification axis.
Presentation independence/equivariance remains mandatory at the scope of any global R2/R3 claim, especially for the H0 Candidate A placement failure.
However, presentation-groupoid machinery by itself does not produce a strict theorem-critical leverage certificate and therefore should not remain the whole mainline search objective.

The broader next realization stage should first identify an independently defined Enterprise operational structure and a strict V2 leverage theorem; presentation naturality/equivariance should then be invoked as a required sub-gate for candidates that depend on presentations.
required_amendments_if_reused: remove information non-factorization as a necessary R2 gate
retain equivariance/coherence only as presentation-naturality qualification
do not interpret composition defects as discoveries without an independently justified leverage theorem
